name: Evil Tuner XXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: Internet radio (Radio Browser: 30,000+ stations by genre, country or search), live shortwave from public KiwiSDR receivers (tuned from the MPC: bands, modes, filter), a phone over Wi-Fi (Roc Droid on Android) or AirPlay (iPhone) played into an MPC track, through an 8-voice granular engine, a multimode filter, eleven character stages, a saturator, an Erica-style delay, plate / reverse / room reverb with shimmer, a 16-step trance gate, stutter, MIDI duck, a tempo-synced looper with a rolling 3-minute tape and stretch renders, and three LFOs. Inspired by the concept of the Endorphin.es Evil Pet (no affiliation, no code). Needs a network.
